description: ClipboardHistory: sessions of add (dedupe, limit), enforce, prune (retention), remove, togglePin, clear and search with fixed dates (seconds since 2001-01-01, as Swift's Date encodes them); search over a fixed history (case- and diacritic-insensitive, pinned first); and the Codable form the Mac app writes to clipboard.json (`history`, or `error` for files it can't read). Items are listed without their ids, which Swift generates at random.
generator: swift run SlatedFixtures (Sources/SlatedFixtures); do not edit by hand

sessions.name: newest first, with the source app
empty and whitespace-only copies aren't kept
copying something again moves it to the top with a new date
a re-copied pinned item stays pinned
duplicates compare as Swift strings (canonical equivalence)
the limit drops the oldest unpinned items
retention with a cutoff between items
search puts pinned matches first and keeps their order
images: copied again moves to the top with its pin; a query never matches one
images without a file or pixels aren't kept; text and images never merge
images count toward the limit and retention, and go with remove and clear
